_doc: Equivalence-prover allowlist. Every entry acknowledges an INTENDED divergence between the current tree and validation/baselines/v68. Entries require file (repo-relative), reason, and wave (e.g. v6.9). The prover fails on any un-allowlisted diff and on any stale entry whose file no longer diverges.

entries.reason: v6.8.1 microcopy fixes: (1) the micro ships-from row now YIELDS when the dedicated az_ships_from line is effective (azShipsAllowed() gate) so the buy box never says Ships-from twice; (2) label resolution unchanged otherwise. Companion CSS guard .cx-az-micro__row[hidden]{display:none!important} fixes the display:flex-defeats-[hidden] bare-truck-icon bug (CSS is outside baseline scope).

v6.10 merchant-selectable ships-from display format: azShipsFormat() decodes the lean 's'/'p' code from the gated ships member (draft override preview.sf only inside a VERIFIED preview session, fail-closed to subtle); azBuildStock gains a shipsName param and a prominent branch (.cx-az-stock__ships--prominent: truck icon + @@COUNTRY@@ sentinel split into prefix/country/suffix, textContent-only, sentinel-less fallback to the plain composed line); azMountStock hoists the warehouse name. Subtle path markup byte-identical to v6.8. Pinned by sims/az-split.cjs F1-F5 + mutants m6/m7.

v6.11 survey methodology full-text editability: surveyBuildPanel's merchant branch substitutes the built-in text's live-number tokens ({{ total }}/{{ yes }}/{{ percent }}, flexible inner whitespace) with the cfg.survey numbers before the textContent write, so a merchant-edited copy of the built-in explanation keeps tracking the survey numbers. Fail-safe 0 on non-finite numbers; sink stays textContent-only. Pinned by sims/survey-methodology.cjs M1-M7 + mutants m1-m4 and harness section-5 v6.11 pins.

v7 per-product proof wave: five-format survey machinery (SURVEY_FORMATS, surveyBuildFormat, buildSurveyDots, cfg.preview.surveyFormat) replaced by one zero-arg outcomes-forward surveyBuildSection (derived row percents, decorative bar fills, @@YES@@/@@TOTAL@@ sentinel labels, fail-closed row/total/rec validation); surveyBuildPanel keeps v6.11 token substitution with per-product numbers (total=sample size, yes=rec); study builder gains the always-on subject line + protocol fact chips and drops m1/m2 paragraphs. v12 per-market product exclusions: new cx_pgid assign ('gid://shopify/Product/' | append: product.id) + cx_exc_dsp flag off cfg.dispatch.excludedByMarket[cx_market] contains cx_pgid; the live dispatch gate gains `and cx_exc_dsp == false`, the draft gate becomes `unless cfg.dispatch.showOnPdp == false or cx_exc_dsp`; the delivery exclusion (cfg.deliveryEstimate.excludedByMarket) FOLDS into cx_del_hidden so live + draft delivery paths are both bound (the byCountry-hidden precedent). No island-member changes — an excluded product simply gets no dispatch/delivery emission, so beacons stay honest for free. Pinned by harness section-5 v12 block.

v12 per-market product exclusions: new az_pgid assign + two flags — the delivery/dispatch exclusion folds into az_del_hidden (az_delivery_line hides on EITHER list: the line bundles the delivery date AND the order-within countdown clause, so either promise being untrue for the product invalidates it — killing az_any_delivery also drops thresholdOk, which azTplPayload keys on), and az_exc_sf off cfg.amazon.shipsFromExcludedByMarket gates the live + draft az_ships_from paths AND the shipsFrom member emission ({%- if az_any_micro and az_exc_sf == false %}) — the member is the micro ships row's ONLY warehouse/defaultLabel source, and dropping `ships` alone would have flipped the micro fallback ON (the v6.8.1 yield rule inverts). Both JS read sites are null-guarded, so the absent member renders nothing. Pinned by harness section-5 v12 block.

v12 per-market product exclusions: two assigns read the CURRENT market's lists (cx_exc_d = cfg.dispatch.excludedByMarket[cx_market], cx_exc_e = cfg.deliveryEstimate.excludedByMarket[cx_market]) and a new gated island member emits them ({%- if cx_exc_d or cx_exc_e %} "exc": {"d": .. | json, "e": .. | json},) between the dc and delivery members — the cart is client-mutable, so the verdict must be computed in JS at render time from state.cart, not baked at Liquid render. Pinned by harness section-5 v12 block; the deploy-safety island matrix parses the new branch.

v12 per-market product exclusions: new CART-ONLY helper cartExcludedAny(list) (state.cart items vs 'gid://shopify/Product/' + product_id; deliberately NOT a pdp twin — the dispatchSchedule per-file rule) plus one early-return gate in renderDispatch (after the cfg.dc check, before the PREVIEW branch) and one in renderDelivery (after featureOn, before deliveryConfig): `if (cartExcludedAny(cfg.exc && cfg.exc.d|e)) return null;`. A null return means no node AND no impression (renderAll only tracks returned feature keys), and renderInto re-runs on every cart rebuild so client-side cart changes re-verdict without a reload. Exclusion applies in preview too (the byCountry-hidden precedent). Pinned by harness section-5 v12 block.

v12 review fix (preview honesty): new DISPATCH_PREVIEW_EXCLUDED constant + a cfg.dspx === 1 branch in mountDispatchPreview's invalid-config path — an exclusion-hidden product in a verified preview session names the exclusion (plain cx-preview-note) instead of rendering the false DISPATCH_PREVIEW_INVALID schedule warning (the island suppresses the dispatch member for excluded products, which mountDispatchPreview otherwise reads as an invalid schedule). The dspx marker is emitted by pdp-booster.liquid ONLY while a preview is armed, so real visitors' payloads are byte-identical. Pinned by harness section-5 v12 block (marker emission + JS branch).

v18 gift diagnostics: new rwGiftWhy() names, in merchant-facing English, the reason the gift pass did or did not put a gift in the cart, and rwUpdateWhy() renders it into the preview bar after every renderAll. Fixes the reported "gifts never get added in preview": rwMutable() requires PREVIEW.rehearsal AND no simulator, so typing a spend into the simulator silently cancelled the "Test with my real cart" tick with no explanation. Decision ORDER is load-bearing (distance to the next tier before the simulator notice, simulator before the rehearsal tick) and is pinned by validation/sims/gift-why.mjs. Also exposes window.CellexiaBooster.giftWhy for live pages. No behaviour change to the gift sync itself: rwSyncGifts, its single-flight, its one-correction-per-cart-signature and its never-loop guarantees are untouched.

v18 gift clusters: the #cx-rw-config island stops dumping the whole rewards settings section and instead emits THIS COUNTRY's cluster slice, sliced out of the new cellexia/gift_plan app-data metafield with cx_country (the pattern gift_stock.paused[cx_market] already used). A browser therefore only ever receives its own ladder, which shrinks the island and stops one country's offers leaking into another's page source. The paused set now rides inside the cluster entry, so the separate "paused" member is gone.

v18: new #cx-gift-config island carrying the same per-country gift slice for the product page, in its OWN script tag rather than inside #cx-pdp-config, so a Liquid problem in the gift data can only break the gift surface (the 2026-08-17 isolation lesson). Gated live-effective on cx_eff_gt exactly like the cart island.

v18 free-gift product-page surface: azGtIsland/azGtCfg/azGtPlan/azBuildGiftSurface/azMountGift render one of three merchant-chosen placements (quiet line above Add to cart, reward card below it, ladder strip under the title). All three are cart-aware and pick the strongest of three sentences, so the line says how far the shopper is from a named gift instead of advertising one. Adds azShopRate/azCurrency/azProductPriceCents (twins of the cart helpers). The card renders after the Add-to-cart actions so a promotion can never push the button down the page.

v18 gift clusters + reward ladder: the storefront readers now consume the per-country cluster slice (rwGtTiers rebuilds {amount,slots} from the plan's a/t arrays, rwPool/rwPaused/rwGiftThresholdCents read the short plan keys, and the country's own amounts arrive pre-resolved as RW.gb instead of a market map lookup). rwRenderLadder draws a card per gift tier under the meter track: unlocked cards keep their tick and stay full-strength, which communicates the cumulative rule with no new copy to translate into 18 languages. The gift sync itself, its single-flight, one-correction-per-cart-signature and never-loop guarantees are untouched.

v20 Liquid diet (paid FIRST, the v19 "slim before you spend" rule): the nine <svg> branches repeated one identical opening tag. The head (class/width/height/viewBox) and the attribute sets are hoisted — one default stroke set, two named exceptions (star = filled, check = stroke-width 2) — and the case now carries only each icon's inner markup. Generated mechanically and proved byte-identical for all 8 keys plus the else branch before the write: 3,610B -> 2,043B (-1,567B), which pays for the v20 image-badge gates + island with ~1.1KB left over. No caller changed.

v20 image badges: +403B of gates and one island member. cx_ibl is the market-scoped live flag (cfg.imageBadges.enabled + marketScopes.image_badges through the house idiom), cx_ibs carries the scale for the live OR preview-drafted case, the island emits "ib": {live, s} under cx_ibs > 0, and the island/CSS/JS emission gate gained `or cx_ibs > 0` so this feature ALONE keeps the asset on the page. A pre-v20 metafield has no cfg.imageBadges, so cx_ibs stays nil and every gate fails closed. Pinned by harness section v20 + sims/image-badges.cjs.

v20 image badges: the ib* module (ibData/ibAllowed/ibScale/ibPhone/ibImageBox/ibBasePx/ibClear/ibSizeFor/ibApply/ibBind/mountImageBadges) plus its call at the top of init(). It paints NOTHING: it measures the theme's own badge row against the live product image and writes --cx-ib-w + .cx-ib-on on the row, which the stylesheet consumes below 576px only.
